from.place: Generalization lifting used to show the affine localization refinement covers V in the closed-neighbourhood argument below the first descent-formula sentence.

title: Generalizations lift along flat scheme morphisms
statement: Let $f:T\to V$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-flat-morphism]. For every $t\in T$ and every $v\in V$ specializing to $f(t)$, there exists $t\prime\in T$ specializing to $t$ such that $f(t\prime)=v$.
